description: Fetch comments on one Instagram post: username, text, timestamp, like_count, reply_count and parent_id for replies. Use this for social listening and campaign verification. Give exactly one of `url` or `shortcode`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–50. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

name: get_instagram_comments
title: Get the comments on an Instagram post
